name: Liz Ann Sonders
zh_summary: Liz Ann Sonders 表示大部分人的收入來自出賣勞力，但這類收入佔個人總收入的比例自1960年代以來長期下降；美國人現在有大量投資、租金與社會保障等政府移轉收入，代表聯準會緊縮貨幣政策來壓抑通膨可能沒那麼有效。附圖：受僱人員報酬佔個人收入約60.3%，1970年前後約73%。沒有提及個股。
text:
Most people get majority of income from selling their labor, however, that type of income has been declining as % of all personal income (long-term trend dating back to 1960s); in addition to wages, Americans now receive significant income from investments, rental properties, and government transfers like Social Security … suggests Fed’s inflation-fighting tools may become less effective (slowing economy via tighter monetary policy doesn’t work as well when people have substantial non-job income)
